reviews.source_assessment: The candidate does not reproduce the photographed Charles body text. In archive-leaf0135-native-page.png, printed p. 97, first body line after LIV., word 3 is ካልእ, not the candidate's ኀበ; word 8 is ቆላ, not ቄላ; and word 9 ends in ቀ, not the candidate's ቃ. The initial fidel of word 9 remains provisionally ዐ rather than securely distinguished from ዕ. native135-units1-2-full.png reproduces the same scan and does not independently resolve that uncertainty. The other source words agree with the frozen transcription: ወነጸርኩ, ወተመየጥኩ, ገጸ, ምድር, ወርእኩ, በህየ, እንዘ, ትነድድ, እሳት. The unit ends after እሳት, before baseline numeral 2. Word separators and final four-dot punctuation are retained. Raised apparatus numbers 28–31 are not source words. No bracket or radial asterisk occurs inside this unit; the cross-shaped beginning of ትነድድ is part of its fidel, and the radial asterisk in unit 2 is outside the boundary. The candidate's empty transcription_uncertainties array is not justified.
reviews.translation_assessment: Whole-unit English approval is withheld. The photographed Latin supports looking, turning, earth, face/surface, a valley or depressed place, depth, burning, and fire at the lexical level described below. It does not justify replacing the photographed ካልእ with ኀበ and translating that replacement as 'toward'. The actual word ካልእ needs its own complete lexical and grammatical control, including its relation to ገጸ ምድር. The candidate presents one first-person observer for look/turn/see and fire as the burning actor, but full control of the seeing entry, the circumstantial construction, and the disputed depth form is incomplete. 'There' also requires control of በህየ rather than an unrelated prepositional entry. No negative, explicit numeral, or independent demonstrative is visible in the photographed unit; English 'a' must not be treated as evidence of an explicit source quantity. The relation expressed by 'with a fire burning' cannot receive final approval without completing the እንዘ control and checking the clause's morphology against the settled source.
reviews.note_assessment: The face/surface explanation has genuine primary Latin support in pp1207.jpg and pp1209.jpg. The remainder of the mandatory note overstates what the supplied controls establish. Columns 592–596 discuss ኀበ, which is not the photographed word at position 3. Column 410 supports the photographed ቆላ entry, not an undocumented substitution of ቄላ into Charles's text. Columns 956–957 supply depth semantics but cannot resolve the uncertain initial fidel or license changing final ቀ to ቃ. These lexical controls do not establish the complete first-person and circumstantial clauses. The claim that controls were 'personally photo-controlled in this follow-up' is a claim about prior work, not primary evidence available to this review. Neither copy of the note is approved as written.
reviews.rationale: There are demonstrable candidate/source discrepancies as well as a decisive uncertainty already preserved in the source freeze. The candidate's spelling and its account of lexical checking cannot resolve either. Several supplied Latin entries provide useful semantic evidence, but necessary continuations and grammatical controls remain unavailable. Accordingly, neither the source nor the complete English and mandatory explanation qualifies for acceptance. HOLD is required rather than a source reconstruction or a familiar-sounding translation.
remaining_decisive_uncertainties: Charles p. 97, first body line after LIV., word 9 immediately after ቆላ: the initial fidel remains insufficiently distinguished as ዐ versus ዕ. A genuinely resolving source image is needed.
A complete original Dillmann entry and grammatical control for the actual third word ካልእ are missing; its meaning and relation to ገጸ ምድር must be established without substituting ኀበ.
The seeing-verb entry begins near the bottom of column 703 and continues beyond column 704. pp705.jpg is not supplied, so the complete relevant entry cannot be checked.
The እንዘ entry continues beyond column 750. pp751.jpg is not supplied, preventing complete control of the circumstantial relation.
The supplied photographs do not furnish a complete dedicated control for በህየ and its locative reference.
The exact depth form and its grammatical relation to ቆላ require resolution after the source fidel uncertainty is settled; lexical 'profundus' alone does not establish the candidate's form.

lexical_controls.head: ወነጸርኩ — ነጸረ
lexical_controls.actual_primary_Latin_support: Columns 701–702 give the main entry, including 'spectare, intueri', 'spectare, inspicere', and 'oculos convertere'. This supports the looking semantic field, not the candidate's entire clause or its substituted directional relation.

lexical_controls.head: ወተመየጥኩ — turning verb
lexical_controls.actual_primary_Latin_support: The root and continuations include 'deflectit, declinavit, transiit' and, for the relevant reflexive/intransitive formation, 'verti (deflecti, declinari), se convertere'; column 216 also has 'versus ... conversus'. These support turning semantics. They do not supply a missing ኀበ in the Charles body text.

lexical_controls.head: ካልእ
lexical_controls.actual_primary_Latin_support: No complete original Latin entry for this photographed source word is supplied. The ኀበ entry cannot serve as its lexical substitute.

lexical_controls.head: ገጸ — ገጽ
lexical_controls.actual_primary_Latin_support: The entry starts in column 1208 and continues through columns 1209–1210. It explicitly gives 'facies' and, at sense 3, 'facies rei i. q. superficies'. This genuinely supports 'surface' for the face-of-earth expression, subject to establishing the full source construction.

lexical_controls.head: ምድር
lexical_controls.actual_primary_Latin_support: Column 217 gives 'terra', with distinctions including 'orbis terrarum', 'regio (provincia, patria)', 'ager, agri', 'humus, solum terrae', and 'terrae elementum vel materia'. The earth semantic field is supported.

lexical_controls.head: ወርእኩ — seeing verb
lexical_controls.actual_primary_Latin_support: The entry beginning low in column 703 gives 'cernere' and discusses an object construction, but it continues beyond the supplied columns 703–704. Complete primary Latin support is unavailable without the continuation.

lexical_controls.head: በህየ
lexical_controls.actual_primary_Latin_support: No complete dedicated entry for this locative expression is supplied. The candidate's ኀበ controls do not establish it.

lexical_controls.head: ቆላ
lexical_controls.actual_primary_Latin_support: Column 410 heads the entry ቆላ and gives 'vallis, locus depressus et humilis, regio (in aereil specie) depressior', followed by a regional application involving 'loca depressa'. This supports valley/depression semantics for the photographed word; it does not prove the candidate's ቄላ spelling.

lexical_controls.head: ዐሙቀ / unresolved initial fidel — depth word
lexical_controls.actual_primary_Latin_support: Columns 956–957 give the depth family, including 'profundum (depressum et cavum) esse vel fieri', adjectival 'profundus (altus)', and nominal 'profunditas, profundum'. These establish the semantic field but do not distinguish the Charles image's initial fidel or resolve the exact inflected form.

lexical_controls.head: እንዘ
lexical_controls.actual_primary_Latin_support: Column 750 identifies a conjunction/preposition and includes 'donec, dum, cum'. The entry continues beyond the photograph; these partial senses cannot establish the complete circumstantial construction here.

lexical_controls.head: ትነድድ — ነደደ
lexical_controls.actual_primary_Latin_support: Column 683 gives the main entry with 'ardere, ardescere, exardescere, flagrare, accensum esse', followed by derived formations and nouns. This supports burning semantics, but the exact clause relation still requires the complete conjunction control.

lexical_controls.head: እሳት
lexical_controls.actual_primary_Latin_support: Column 749 gives 'ignis' and further fire-related applications. It supports 'fire', not by itself an explicit indefinite quantity or the English 'with' relation.

lexical_controls.head: ኀበ — candidate-only replacement
lexical_controls.actual_primary_Latin_support: Columns 592–596 give prepositional and relative uses, including 'ad, apud, juxta' and motion 'ad locum, rem, personam'. Those are real primary Latin controls for ኀበ, but Charles's photographed third word is ካልእ. They therefore cannot justify the candidate's source substitution or its 'toward' rendering.
